Title: Vendor contract summariser
Business Challenge: Vendor contracts run to dozens of pages and renewal terms are easy to miss.
Current Process: A paralegal reads each contract and copies the key dates and clauses into a sheet.

Title: Desk booking assistant
Team Members and Lead: Priya Nair (Lead); Tomasz Wiśniewski (Sponsor); Rhys Llewellyn
Business Challenge: Staff cannot easily see which desks are free and often book ones that are already taken.
Current Process: People email the floor team, who check a spreadsheet and reply by hand.

Title: Onboarding checklist helper
Business Challenge: New joiners receive checklists from several teams and nobody sees what is still open.
Current Process: Each team sends its own checklist by email and the manager chases the gaps.

Title: Expense anomaly finder
Team Members and Lead: Ingrid Solberg (Lead); Noor El-Sayed (Sponsor); Hana Kobayashi
Business Challenge: Unusual expense claims are only spotted when a reviewer happens to notice them.
Current Process: Reviewers sample a few claims each week and compare them with the policy by eye.

Title: Meeting notes to actions
Business Challenge: Actions agreed in meetings are lost because nobody writes them up the same day.
Current Process: Someone types up notes afterwards and emails the actions to each owner.

Title: Travel policy assistant
Business Challenge: Travellers keep asking the same questions about what the travel policy allows.
Current Process: The travel desk answers each question by email and links to the policy PDF.

Business Challenge: Facilities requests arrive by phone, email and chat and are sorted by hand.
Current Process: A coordinator reads each request and forwards it to the right vendor.

Title: Procurement FAQ bot
Team Members and Lead: Kwame Mensah (Lead); Avery Chen (Sponsor); Zainab Okafor
Business Challenge: Business teams ask procurement the same questions about thresholds and approved suppliers.
Current Process: Procurement answers each question by email using a shared FAQ document.
